sentences.en: Was it necessary to inflict such a punishment on him?
sentences.zh: 他有必要受到这么严厉的惩罚吗？

sentences.en: You should not inflict any injury on others on any account.
sentences.zh: 你无论如何都不应该伤害他人。

sentences.en: A sadist likes inflicting pain; a masochist, receiving it.
sentences.zh: 虐待狂喜欢施加痛苦；受虐狂则相反。

senses.zh: 把…强加给，使承受，遭受,给予（打击等）,处以刑罚，加刑

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（使…）+flict（打击）→使…遭受打击→使…遭受
